access_codes_uses_check.name: access_codes_uses_check
access_codes_uses_check.value: max_uses > 0 AND uses_count >= 0 AND uses_count <= max_uses

admin_invitation_oauth_transfer_state_ch.name: admin_invitation_oauth_transfer_state_check
admin_invitation_oauth_transfer_state_ch.value: ("admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."transfer_code_hash" IS NULL AND "admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."transfer_expires_at" IS NULL AND "admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."transfer_consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."transfer_code_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."transfer_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."pending_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

admin_invitation_oauth_pending_user_stat.name: admin_invitation_oauth_pending_user_state_check
admin_invitation_oauth_pending_user_stat.value: "admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."pending_user_id" IS NULL OR "admin_invitation_oauth_transactions"."start_consumed_at" IS NOT NULL

admin_invitations_acceptance_check.name: admin_invitations_acceptance_check
admin_invitations_acceptance_check.value: ("admin_invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NULL OR "admin_invitations"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)

admin_super_login_oauth_transfer_state_c.name: admin_super_login_oauth_transfer_state_check
admin_super_login_oauth_transfer_state_c.value: ("admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."transfer_code_hash" IS NULL AND "admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."transfer_expires_at" IS NULL AND "admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."transfer_consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."transfer_code_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."transfer_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

admin_super_login_oauth_user_state_check.name: admin_super_login_oauth_user_state_check
admin_super_login_oauth_user_state_check.value: "admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."user_id" IS NULL OR "admin_super_login_oauth_transactions"."start_consumed_at" IS NOT NULL

subscriptions_split_check.name: subscriptions_split_check
subscriptions_split_check.value: (plan IS NULL AND university_id IS NULL AND share_bps IS NULL AND university_amount IS NULL AND platform_amount IS NULL) OR (plan IS NOT NULL AND university_id IS NOT NULL AND share_bps IS NOT NULL AND university_amount IS NOT NULL AND platform_amount IS NOT NULL AND share_bps >= 0 AND share_bps <= 10000 AND university_amount >= 0 AND platform_amount >= 0 AND university_amount + platform_amount = amount)

users_role_university_scope_check.name: users_role_university_scope_check
users_role_university_scope_check.value: ("users"."role"::text IN ('super_admin', 'super_admin_editor', 'super_admin_lector') AND "users"."university_id" IS NULL) OR ("users"."role"::text NOT IN ('super_admin', 'super_admin_editor', 'super_admin_lector') AND "users"."university_id" IS NOT NULL)
